5:1.name: Hero
5:1.designContext:
Frame "Hero": fill color/hero-bg, centered text, padding 120 vertical.
- Title "Crie mais rápido": Arial Bold 56px, white.
- Subtitle "Do Figma ao código sem retrabalho.": 20px, color/hero-muted.
- CTA "Começar agora": fill color/primary, white bold text, padding 14×24, radius 8.

Prototype / motion (Smart Animate on page load):
- Title and subtitle: opacity 0→1 and translateY 8px→0, duration motion/duration-enter (200ms), easing motion/easing-enter (ease-out).
- CTA: same animation with a 50ms delay.
- Accessibility note from the designer: when the user prefers reduced motion, show everything immediately with no animation.
